notes.title: Going Free
notes.notes: Attention all: We are so very thankful for all of the support we have received over the past few years. Times change and now we want to give back to the gamers. We are going to be working with Valve to make our current games free for all going forward. If you have already purchased from us, we thank you immensely and hope you have enjoyed your time with our games. For those considering buying our products, please hold off as we make this transition. Thank you all again!
